title: ABRIDGED BID NOTICE UNDER OPEN DOMESTIC BIDDING - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# ABRIDGED BID NOTICE UNDER OPEN DOMESTIC BIDDING
Uganda Revenue Authority invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for:
Procurement Reference Number
Subject Matter of the Procurement
Bid Security
Date of Pre-bid
Date of Bid
URA/NCON/ITID/25-26/00779
Provision of support and maintenance of Radware Solution
UGX 4,000,000
22 nd October, 2025 at 10:00am
3 rd November, 2025                         at 10:00am on 13 th Floor URA Tower Procurement Office
URA/NCON/CSD/25-26/00654
Provision o partitioning works for offices and server rooms at Kampala central business area office f Cleaning Services for Various URA Offices
UGX 15,000,000
22 nd October, 2025 at 10:00am
7 th November, 2025                       at 10:00am on 13 th Floor URA Tower Procurement Office
The Bidding document shall be inspected, issued and delivered at;
The Assistant Commissioner, Procurement and Disposal Division,
Uganda Revenue Authority
Plot M193/M194 Nakawa Industrial Area
P.O. Box 7279, Kampala, Uganda
13 th Floor, URA Tower
Tel 256(0)417442155/6/7/8/9
Fax 256(0)414334253
The Bidding document in English may be collected by interested bidders upon submission of a written application letter to the Assistant Commissioner Procurement and Disposal Division at the address in (2) above.
Bidders are advised to collect Bank Payment Registration Slips at the address in (2) above and make payment of a non-refundable fee of Ugx: 100,000 for the bidding document to any of the 21 banks authorised to receive Non-Tax Revenue fees on behalf of URA.
The detailed bid notice is available at the Entity’s website at ura.go.ug and at www.ppda.go.ug
ACCOUNTING OFFICER
